evals.prompt: 这个功能已经跑通了，帮我提交并推到 GitHub。记得不要把我本地没关系的改动也带上。
evals.expected_output: A safe checkpoint workflow that inspects status, branch, remote, relevant changes, verifies when practical, stages only related files, commits with a Conventional Commit message, and pushes safely.
expectations: The workflow inspects git status, current branch, remote, and sync state before staging.
The response avoids staging unrelated work.
The commit message follows Conventional Commit style.
The push result and any remaining changes are reported.

evals.prompt: 给这次改动做一个 checkpoint commit 就行，先不要 push。改动是修复登录后跳转到空白页的问题。
evals.expected_output: A local-only checkpoint commit workflow that does not push because the user explicitly asked not to push.
expectations: The workflow creates or proposes a coherent local commit only.
The response does not push to a remote.
The commit message reflects a login redirect bug fix.

evals.prompt: 保存进度：我刚把 skill 的触发描述都调完了。你看一下 git 状态，帮我弄个规范 commit，如果有远端就推上去。
evals.expected_output: A checkpoint workflow that checks repository state, validates the completed milestone, commits only the skill description changes, and pushes only when a remote is available and safe.
expectations: The workflow treats this as a completed documentation/skill metadata checkpoint.
The response checks whether a remote exists before pushing.
The response does not claim a push if no remote or safe upstream is available.
